import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to numerical
df['sex'] = df['sex'].map({'male': 0, 'female': 1})
df['embarked'] = df['embarked'].map({'S': 0, 'C': 1, 'Q': 2})
df['class'] = df['class'].map({'Third': 0, 'First': 1, 'Second': 2})

# Create a bar chart to show survival by sex
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(x='sex', y='survived', data=df)
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Survived')
plt.title('Survival by Sex')
plt.xticks([0, 1], ['Male', 'Female'])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show age distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(df['age'], kde=True)
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Age Distribution')
plt.savefig('output_age.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to show fare vs age
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='age', y='fare', hue='survived', data=df)
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Fare')
plt.title('Fare vs Age')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output_fare_age.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
